scope: Independent text-only check of the six rows marked REPAIR_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_CHECK. No fluency approval.

rows.englishSource: It's set up for students — not your role. Head back to your own home to keep going.
rows.rootCandidate: E etseditswe baithuti — eseng role ya hao. Kgutlela leqepheng la hao la lapeng hore o tswele pele.
rows.approvedCandidate: E etseditswe baithuti — eseng role ya hao. Kgutlela leqepheng la hao la lapeng hore o tswele pele.
rows.backTranslation: This is set up for students — not your role. Return to your own home page to continue.
rows.semanticCheck: “Role” as a loan preserves the account permission/role meaning; “mosebetsi” could suggest a job. The return-home instruction and continuation remain.
rows.uncertainty: Check whether “role” loan is understood in this UI context.

rows.englishSource: You have finished every module. Build your final design plan-set in the Design Studio — that is your completion artifact for the course.
rows.rootCandidate: O qetile dimojule tsohle. Haha sephuthelo sa hao sa ho qetela sa meralo ho Design Studio — ke sona mosebetsi wa hao wa ho phethela thupelo.
rows.approvedCandidate: O qetile dimojule tsohle. Haha sephuthelo sa hao sa ho qetela sa meralo ho Design Studio — ke sona mosebetsi wa hao wa ho phethela thupelo.
rows.backTranslation: You finished all modules. Build your final design plan-set in Design Studio — that is your work for completing the course.
rows.semanticCheck: Removing “ya polasi” avoids adding farm-specific scope. The final design plan-set and Design Studio remain. “Mosebetsi wa hao” conveys completion work, though it is less explicit than “completion artifact”; retain “plan-set” as technical meaning for reviewer if needed.
rows.uncertainty: The exact “artifact” nuance is compressed to work/deliverable; speaker should confirm this is sufficient.

rows.englishSource: You have completed the full ImbewuField permaculture curriculum. If you have a mentor, they will see this progress next time they check in.
rows.rootCandidate: O phethile kharikhulamo yohle ya ImbewuField ya permaculture. Haeba o na le moeletsi, o tla bona tsoelo-pele ena ha a boela a sheba.
rows.approvedCandidate: O phethile kharikhulamo yohle ya ImbewuField ya permaculture. Haeba o na le moeletsi, o tla bona tsoelo-pele ena ha a boela a sheba.
rows.backTranslation: You completed the full ImbewuField permaculture curriculum. If you have a mentor, they will see this progress the next time they check.
rows.semanticCheck: Haeba makes the mentor clause explicitly conditional, avoiding a possible imperative reading; if the learner has a mentor, the mentor sees progress on next check-in.
rows.uncertainty: “Kharikhulamo” is a borrowed term; semantics match the source.

rows.englishSource: Open still image for {title} at full size
rows.rootCandidate: Bula setshwantsho se sa sisinyeheng sa {title} ka boholo bo felletseng
rows.approvedCandidate: Bula setshwantsho se sa sisinyeheng sa {title} ka boholo bo felletseng
rows.backTranslation: Open the non-moving still image for {title} at full size.
rows.semanticCheck: “Se sa sisinyeheng” explicitly distinguishes a still image from a moving animation/video; full-size and {title} remain.
rows.uncertainty: Clunky but meaning-preserving; verify whether this phrase is natural in Sesotho.

rows.semanticCheck: Atamisa is the existing locale’s zoom verb and keeps the slide-image/zoom action.

rows.rootCandidate: Dintho tse jarollwang bakeng sa diselaete tsa puo eo o e kgethileng
rows.approvedCandidate: Dintho tse jarollwang bakeng sa diselaete tsa puo eo o e kgethileng
rows.backTranslation: Downloadable contents for slides in the language you selected.
rows.semanticCheck: Names downloadable contents for slides in the selected language, avoiding the misleading implication of a geographic region.
rows.uncertainty: Phrase is longer than source but scope is accurate.

broaderCheck.result: No omitted ordinary clause found in the original 66 proposals. The facilitator video row was included.
broaderCheck.source: Facilitator training video — for in-person sessions, not for streaming here.
broaderCheck.candidate: Video ya thupelo ya batsamaisi — ke ya mananeo a shebaneng ka seqo; ha e shebellwe ka inthanete mona.
broaderCheck.note: The source content is represented: facilitator training video, face-to-face sessions, and not streamed here. “Ha e shebellwe ka inthanete” reads as “not watched online,” which shifts streaming into viewing; consider revising to “ha e haswe ka inthanete mona” (“it is not streamed online here”) after a Sesotho reviewer confirms the broadcast verb and “mananeo” for sessions.
